name: Wartime Standard Type B cargo ship
blurb: A hostile merchant transport, the target of strike missions. It does not score when sunk yet.
history:
Japan built standardized cargo ships during the war. Mimasaka Maru was one of 18 Wartime Standard Type B cargo ships laid down in 1943 and 1944, seven of them at the Tokyo yard of Ishikawajima Shipbuilding & Engineering. She was completed on 6 February 1944 for Nippon Yusen, and on 9 April 1944 the American submarine USS Seahorse torpedoed and sank her near the Mariana Islands.

The ship in this game is a generic wartime standard cargo ship, not any single vessel. "Maru", meaning "circle", is a word Japanese merchant ship names often end with, not the name of one ship.
